theme: A quiet Sunday with the girls, closed out by one Zoom.
greeting: The day is almost entirely yours, Dan — the girls are here in St. Pete and the only fixed point left is the island associations' annual meeting at 5. A handful of travel bookings have been drifting, though, and a couple of their windows are closing.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: Open since Sept 14 (p1). A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and sells out — book it refundable now and fix the dates later. Once the Pathfinder is south, there's no six-seater in Maine for the girls' Christmas trip.

needsAttention.title: December break destination
needsAttention.detail: Book-by was Oct 15 and the shortlist is still open (p2). Three weeks, all four girls, Dec 13 – Jan 2 — the thinnest holiday inventory of the year. Pick domestic vs. international and lock one path.

needsAttention.title: DIRA & DIBA annual meeting
needsAttention.detail: The Bridge and Road Association annual meeting is at 5 PM on Zoom; the materials came in a separate email — worth a skim before you join.

needsAttention.title: Term life quotes for Mike
needsAttention.detail: Overdue since Sept 25 (p2), stuck on two inputs: target coverage amount and term length. Settle those and the shopping goes fast.

flagged.title: Baker Tilly MD role
flagged.detail: LinkedIn alert — Managing Director, Industrial Products, Managed Services.

flagged.title: Venmo request, $50
flagged.detail: Joshua Weaver, for mowing on Oct 14.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and promos — St. Pete beehiiv, Monocle, Trip.com, a couple of language digests.
inbox.clear: No personal emails are waiting on your reply.

recipe.title: Braised Pheasant with Mushrooms and Bacon
recipe.why: Game and wild mushrooms hit their autumn peak now, perfect for a slow, savory braise on a cool October evening.

Pathfinder drive, Portland to St Pete

acts.line: One 15-minute board sweep with Mike is the week's only standing work beat.
The long middle is open — the girls are here, and the garden and kitchen are yours.
The island associations' annual meeting closes the day on Zoom.
